name: 离散型 EWM – 库存盘点 (4RR)
description_en_html:
Overview

In this scope item, you can plan, conduct, and confirm regular counts of actual product quantities in the warehouse and compare the physical stock to the data in the system. You first create physical inventory documents for a chosen number of storage bins or products or based on cycle counting indicators. The cycle counting method is used to count products at regular intervals during a year. You can set up counting intervals based on cycle count indicators. After the documents are created and printed, you count the stock in the warehouse. You enter the count result in the system and review discrepancies in the system quantities. By posting the PI documents, you adjust the book inventory in the storage bins to align it with the physical inventory counts. The inventory may be recounted until final counts are accepted. Finally, inventory differences are posted to reconcile stocks in the Decentralized EWM based on SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system.

Key Process Flow

  • Variant 1: Create and print counting document
  • Variant 2: Create and print cycle counting document
  • Enter count results
  • Confirm inventory count results
  • Analyze and post differences

Business Benefits

  • Ensure an accurate accounting of the inventory in the warehouse
  • Leverage several physical inventory methods
  • Map your warehouse complex in the system down to a storage bin level
  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse processes
description_zh_html:
概览

在此范围项目中，您可以计划、执行和确认仓库中实际产品数量的定期盘点，并将实际库存与系统中的数据进行比较。首先为所选数量的仓位或产品创建库存盘点凭证，或基于周期盘点标识。周期盘点方法用于在一年内定期盘点产品。您可以根据周期盘点标识设置盘点间隔。创建并打印凭证后，盘点仓库中的库存。在系统中输入盘点结果，并检查系统数量中的差异。通过过账库存盘点凭证，可以调整仓位中的账面库存，使其与实际库存盘点保持一致。在接受最终盘点之前，可以重新盘点库存。最后，过账库存差异以基于 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统对账分散式 EWM 中的库存。

关键流程流

  • 变式 1：创建并打印盘点凭证
  • 变式 2：创建并打印周期盘点凭证
  • 输入盘点结果
  • 确认库存盘点结果
  • 分析和过账差异

业务优势

  • 确保准确核算仓库中的库存。
  • 利用多种库存盘点方法
  • 将系统中的综合仓库映射到仓位级别。
  • 提高仓库流程的可视性和控制力
